digest.component_or_area: CI/CD workflow - GitHub Actions pytest execution
propositions: Experiment attempted to move macOS pytest temporary files from runner.temp to an ephemeral APFS RAM disk to reduce Gerrit Verify wall time, following precedent from Apple Git CI and Aeron projects

Treatment runs showed no measurable improvement over exact no-RAM control: all four treatment runs (18m43s, 20m54s, 18m26s, 20m00s default) were slower than the 17m26s control, falling short of the predeclared 5% improvement threshold (16m33.7s)
RAM-disk setup and cleanup lifecycle added 71-98 seconds of observability overhead and exposed unrelated defects in snapshot fixture permissions and nested pytest cacheprovider inheritance

Experiment was rejected and reverted per AC7 retention oracle; both macOS default and integration pytest tiers now continue using runner.temp byte-for-byte with unchanged selectors, markers, worker counts, timeouts, and coverage behavior

Secondary repairs fixed intentionally owner-nonwritable workflow snapshot fixtures that raised PermissionError during recursive basetemp cleanup and a nested pytest cacheprovider leak affecting Ubuntu test isolation

Final merged state removes the RAM-disk lifecycle entirely, restores unchanged pytest routing to runner.temp with distinct default/integration basetemps, and retains only test-local snapshot cleanup regression protection
